WHO_description: Exercises with or without equipment for inspiratory and/or expiratory muscles. Guided or assisted by a health worker; self-directed only where feasible after education and advice.
frequency: Not specified in the WHO resource table
equipment_or_resources: Respiratory resistance training devices; resistance bands; mouthpieces; nose clips; disinfection liquid
target_population: Adults with COPD, including acute exacerbation

WHO_description: Techniques to control respiratory rate, such as pursed-lip, paced or diaphragmatic breathing, and facilitate inhalation/exhalation, including breath-relieving positioning. May help reduce dyspnoea at rest or during exertion and support relaxation. Guided or assisted by a health worker; self-directed only where feasible after education and advice.

equipment_or_resources: No material resources listed in the WHO table
target_population: Adults with COPD, including acute exacerbation

WHO_description: Aim to reduce energy use during exertion to help prevent dyspnoea and physical exhaustion.
